note: Foods that the selection rule leaves out but a shipped dish names, so that the dish line can point at the catalogue (docs/ingredient-catalogue.md#named-foods). Each is a USDA SR Legacy FDC id with the reason. `volume` lists portion modifiers (exact text) that count as a volume although the general rule does not accept them; `unit` is the generator's unit and `per` how many of it one portion is. `piece` is the exact modifier of the portion of amount 1 that is one piece. A named food without either is a row for mass amounts only. No number is written here: every number is read from the dataset.
